controlPolicy: Every source requirement has multiple independently reviewable control cases.
Positive, negative, failure, recovery, audit, configuration, static-scan and performance scenarios are tagged separately.
All scenarios are test-design artifacts; no physical/database/app/provider test has been executed.
Every case requires evidence; expected outcomes are proposed acceptance criteria from the baseline, not reported results.
Runtime execution must wait until all four package A-Z implementations finish.

controls.scenario: Scan source/config/build artifacts for credential literals, private keys and live provider secrets.
controls.expectedResult: No active secret appears in source or distributable client artifacts.
controls.evidenceRequired: Secret scan report with redacted findings.

controls.scenario: Attempt to use a revoked/old test credential after a documented rotation.
controls.expectedResult: Old credential is rejected; the new isolated TEST credential remains usable.
controls.evidenceRequired: Credential rotation evidence; no credential values in logs.

controls.scenario: Call the configured API through the approved HTTPS endpoint in the target LIVE build.
controls.expectedResult: Valid HTTPS request is accepted without leaking sensitive redirects.

controls.scenario: Attempt cleartext HTTP or a non-approved ingress route for a remote LIVE endpoint.
controls.expectedResult: Cleartext is denied or redirected safely; unapproved ingress is not exposed.

controls.scenario: Use a valid, unexpired session and then log out.
controls.expectedResult: Valid session works before logout and is revoked after logout.

controls.scenario: Replay an expired/revoked session or a session invalidated by role/account change.
controls.expectedResult: Protected request is denied.
controls.evidenceRequired: Auth integration logs correlated by requestId.

controls.scenario: Read/mutate an object owned by the authorized actor with required permission.
controls.expectedResult: Authorized object operation follows server policy.

controls.scenario: Use a different actor/object ID to access another user’s private resource.
controls.expectedResult: Backend rejects cross-object access without disclosing resource data.

controls.scenario: Perform an operation inside the assigned GLOBAL/STATE/CITY authorization scope.
controls.expectedResult: Only data within the authorized scope is returned/mutated.
controls.evidenceRequired: Scoped test fixtures and response evidence.

controls.scenario: Try outside-scope list/detail/create/update/delete/export/nested-object routes.
controls.expectedResult: Every forbidden operation is rejected server-side.

controls.scenario: Authorized Admin completes a high-impact action after required re-auth/MFA policy is satisfied.
controls.expectedResult: Action succeeds and records actor, target, result and requestId.

controls.scenario: Low-privilege Admin attempts configuration, refund, role or release action.
controls.expectedResult: Request is denied and denial is logged safely.

controls.scenario: Send requests within the approved per-actor/IP limits.
controls.expectedResult: Normal requests remain usable.

controls.scenario: Exceed authentication/OTP/search/callback limits or send oversized request.
controls.expectedResult: Bounded 429/validation rejection occurs without resource exhaustion.
controls.evidenceRequired: Abuse test and bounded resource metrics.

controls.scenario: Submit a well-formed request within documented body/query/file bounds.
controls.expectedResult: Request schema validation accepts the valid form.

controls.scenario: Submit unknown enum, malformed JSON, out-of-range fields or oversized file/body.
controls.expectedResult: Request is rejected with stable safe validation error.

controls.scenario: Exercise errors and slow-request telemetry with synthetic sensitive query values and credentials.
controls.expectedResult: Logs and responses contain no query secrets, OTPs, tokens, credentials or raw request body.
controls.evidenceRequired: Redacted log capture; values must be synthetic.

controls.scenario: Send intentionally malformed payload with marker secrets and inspect server/admin diagnostics.
controls.expectedResult: Secret markers are absent from logs, alerts and client error output.

controls.scenario: Send a correctly signed current webhook whose resource/amount/currency matches the pending transaction.
controls.expectedResult: Provider state is reconciled once.

controls.scenario: Replay, forge or alter a webhook signature, timestamp, resource ID or amount.
controls.expectedResult: Forged/replayed/mismatched webhook is rejected or deduplicated without financial side effect.

controls.scenario: Authorized owner uploads/downloads an allowed file using a current short-lived signed URL.
controls.expectedResult: Only approved object operation succeeds and URL expires as configured.

controls.scenario: Anonymous or another user requests private object/expired URL/invalid MIME or oversized file.
controls.expectedResult: Access/upload is denied.

controls.scenario: Load Admin Web from an approved configured origin.
controls.expectedResult: Required secure headers are present and expected frontend operation works.

controls.scenario: Attempt an untrusted Origin, unsafe framing or disallowed cross-origin mutation.
controls.expectedResult: CORS/content-security policy blocks unauthorized browser access.

controls.scenario: Generate dependency inventory/SBOM and run approved vulnerability audit from lockfiles.
controls.expectedResult: Dependency versions and findings are reproducibly recorded.

controls.scenario: Evaluate a deliberately vulnerable dependency in an isolated test fixture.
controls.expectedResult: Release gate flags it according to approved severity/exception policy.

controls.scenario: Execute an authorized material admin change with a synthetic non-sensitive before/after value.
controls.expectedResult: Audit record includes actor, target, action, result, requestId and safe minimal data.

controls.scenario: Attempt to place secret/token/OTP in a sensitive audit field.
controls.expectedResult: Producer redaction/allowlist prevents secret persistence.

controls.scenario: Rotate one TEST provider/service credential using an approved procedure.
controls.expectedResult: New credential works without uncontrolled interruption.

controls.scenario: Retry operation using the revoked credential.
controls.expectedResult: Old credential is rejected and alert/response is safe.
controls.evidenceRequired: Revocation evidence; no secret values recorded.

controls.scenario: Send request without requestId and inspect response/log correlation.
controls.expectedResult: Server assigns ID and uses same ID for response and relevant diagnostics.

controls.scenario: Send malformed/oversized caller request ID including control characters.
controls.expectedResult: Server uses a bounded safe correlation value and never treats it as authentication.

controls.scenario: Cause a controlled validation/business error through each API client.
controls.expectedResult: Stable machine-readable error code/message/requestId is returned.

controls.scenario: Trigger an unexpected internal exception with a synthetic marker.
controls.expectedResult: No stack trace, secret or raw internal exception details are returned.

controls.scenario: Repeat one booking/payment-intent/job create with the same idempotency key.
controls.expectedResult: Exactly one logical resource/effect is created and stable result returned.

controls.scenario: Reuse one idempotency key with a materially different payload.
controls.expectedResult: Conflicting reuse is rejected, not silently mapped to a different action.

controls.scenario: Perform a critical state update that requires audit/outbox publication.
controls.expectedResult: Business state and required audit/outbox entries commit atomically.

controls.scenario: Inject transaction failure between state write and audit/outbox persistence.
controls.expectedResult: No partial critical state is committed; retry follows approved idempotency.

controls.scenario: Apply one allowed state transition with correct actor and preconditions.
controls.expectedResult: Exactly the intended transition occurs.

controls.scenario: Race two drivers accepting the same offer and try an illegal/out-of-order transition.
controls.expectedResult: Only one winner persists; invalid transition is rejected.

controls.scenario: Insert a valid record respecting required relationships and unique keys.
controls.expectedResult: Database accepts the valid record.

controls.scenario: Attempt duplicate unique key, missing foreign key or invalid invariant.
controls.expectedResult: Database/Backend rejects the invalid write atomically.

controls.scenario: Apply approved migration sequence to a clean disposable local database.
controls.expectedResult: Schema reaches expected version with recorded migration state.

controls.scenario: Inject migration failure in disposable test database and recover using approved strategy.
controls.expectedResult: No old/production database is touched; recovery is repeatable.

controls.scenario: Compare route mounts/handlers against canonical API specification.
controls.expectedResult: Each public route has method, request/response, auth/scope and error semantics recorded.

controls.scenario: Call route with missing/invalid auth or invalid request against the spec.
controls.expectedResult: Actual rejection matches the documented contract.

controls.scenario: Request list/search with valid cursor/page and allowed limit.
controls.expectedResult: Stable page boundaries and continuation metadata are returned.

controls.scenario: Request unbounded limit, invalid cursor or expensive unconstrained query.
controls.expectedResult: Request is bounded/rejected and query cost is limited.

controls.scenario: Simulate slow/unavailable external provider.
controls.expectedResult: Request times out within approved limit and reports a safe classified error.

controls.scenario: Retry an operation explicitly classified as safe and idempotent.
controls.expectedResult: Bounded retry policy applies without duplicating business effects.

controls.scenario: Make an upstream dependency unavailable for the approved circuit-breaker window.
controls.expectedResult: Calls fail boundedly and do not exhaust threads/sockets.

controls.scenario: Restore dependency after the failure threshold.
controls.expectedResult: Circuit recovers according to policy and normal traffic resumes.

controls.scenario: Authorized owner changes a feature/system setting through approved configuration workflow.
controls.expectedResult: Change is versioned, audited and applies according to documented scope.

controls.scenario: Unauthorized actor or malformed configuration attempts to enable risky behavior.
controls.expectedResult: Change is denied or rejected; safe default remains.

controls.scenario: Verify correct OTP for the same actor and exact purposeCode.
controls.expectedResult: Only the matching, valid challenge succeeds.
controls.evidenceRequired: OTP verification trace using synthetic code.

controls.scenario: Submit valid-looking code with another actor or different purposeCode.
controls.expectedResult: Verification is rejected and no protected action occurs.

controls.scenario: Verify OTP before its approved expiry with correct actor/purpose.
controls.expectedResult: A valid challenge may pass within policy.

controls.scenario: Verify after expiry or concurrently race wrong attempts through cutoff.
controls.expectedResult: Expired challenge is invalid and cutoff is atomic; no extra attempt bypass.

controls.scenario: Request resend after configured interval and within configured maximum.
controls.expectedResult: Resend is accepted only when eligible.

controls.scenario: Resend inside cooldown or beyond maximum resend count.
controls.expectedResult: Request is rejected/cooldown applied as approved; no accidental reset.

controls.scenario: Generate a purpose configured for PUSH and confirm correct route.
controls.expectedResult: Delivery uses the configured PUSH adapter.

controls.scenario: Make PUSH delivery unavailable for a PUSH-only purpose.
controls.expectedResult: No SMS/provider fallback occurs unless an explicit approved purpose configuration changes it.

controls.scenario: Resend a challenge with known remaining attempts.
controls.expectedResult: Old code is invalidated; new challenge carries forward remaining attempts.

controls.scenario: Replay the old code or repeat an accepted/replaced challenge.
controls.expectedResult: Replay fails and cannot execute action twice.

controls.scenario: Reach the fifth wrong attempt using a synthetic account/challenge.
controls.expectedResult: Admin alert is created with allowed actor/purpose/time/reason metadata.

controls.scenario: Inspect the alert, notification and diagnostic payloads.
controls.expectedResult: OTP plaintext, tokens and unnecessary personal data are absent.

controls.scenario: Authorized change/bulk change to OTP purpose configuration.
controls.expectedResult: Expected global/field versions and audit records are created.

controls.scenario: Unauthorized change or rollback to missing/deleted version.
controls.expectedResult: Operation is rejected; existing active challenges retain approved generation-time behavior.

controls.scenario: Perform every approved booking/trip transition with correct actor/preconditions.
controls.expectedResult: Only enumerated transitions are accepted and timestamps/state history are coherent.
controls.evidenceRequired: State-machine transition table and test evidence.

controls.scenario: Attempt skipped, stale, wrong-actor, expired or terminal-state transition.
controls.expectedResult: Backend rejects illegal transition without partial side effect.

controls.scenario: Eligible driver accepts an available offer.
controls.expectedResult: Backend atomically assigns the accepted driver.

controls.scenario: Race two eligible drivers against the same offer.
controls.expectedResult: Exactly one driver wins; loser receives conflict/current state.

controls.scenario: Request available service using a compatible active vehicle/location.
controls.expectedResult: Eligible category is returned and accepted.

controls.scenario: Submit unavailable, inactive, incompatible or out-of-serviceable-area vehicle.
controls.expectedResult: Backend rejects the ineligible assignment/booking.

controls.scenario: Create Sharing/Connection/Event booking within approved capacity and goods/parcel payload limit.
controls.expectedResult: Server persists permitted passenger/cargo counts.

controls.scenario: Exceed capacity/payload or provide passenger count where Full Ride contract must omit/ignore collection.
controls.expectedResult: Invalid payload is rejected/normalized exactly as approved rules specify.

controls.scenario: Verify QR/OTP for the correct trip, actor, purpose and valid state.
controls.expectedResult: Trip advances only to the approved next state.

controls.scenario: Use wrong actor/trip/purpose, expired QR/OTP or invalid trip state.
controls.expectedResult: Verification fails and trip state remains unchanged.

controls.scenario: Submit onboarding with active, valid state/city and serviceability assignment.
controls.expectedResult: Submission is eligible to proceed to review.

controls.scenario: Submit with missing, disabled, mismatched or non-serviceable state/city.
controls.expectedResult: Submission is blocked server-side.

controls.scenario: Send a location update within configured freshness window.
controls.expectedResult: Matching can consider the location according to service rules.

controls.scenario: Use stale/out-of-order location for matching.
controls.expectedResult: Driver is excluded/marked stale according to approved policy.

controls.scenario: Submit an approved synthetic suspicious-location signal.
controls.expectedResult: Signal is audited and relevant Admin alert is raised.

controls.scenario: Trigger one suspicious signal where auto-stop is not approved.
controls.expectedResult: System does not automatically stop driver/trip contrary to policy.

controls.scenario: Customer/Driver triggers SOS and the alert is accepted.
controls.expectedResult: SOS is durably represented with status, actor/trip context and escalation record.

controls.scenario: Simulate notification/network failure after SOS creation.
controls.expectedResult: Alert remains recorded with retry/status; UI does not falsely imply dispatch completion.

controls.scenario: Create a delivery job and receive accepted/job ID response.
controls.expectedResult: Job ID and state are durable and queryable.

controls.scenario: Restart Provider after job acceptance.
controls.expectedResult: Accepted job survives restart with unchanged identity and recoverable state.

controls.scenario: Claim a job using correct registered device identity.
controls.expectedResult: Claim has a unique expiring lease/token and attempt identity.

controls.scenario: Let a lease expire or crash the claimed worker/device.
controls.expectedResult: Job becomes safely reclaimable without dual live ownership.

controls.scenario: Acknowledge a delivered/terminal command once.
controls.expectedResult: Correct terminal state is persisted.

controls.scenario: Send duplicate, late or contradictory ACK after terminal state.
controls.expectedResult: State does not regress and business effect is not repeated.

controls.scenario: Send authenticated signed callback with current timestamp and unique result.
controls.expectedResult: Callback is verified and idempotently reconciled.

controls.scenario: Send unsigned, forged, replayed or expired-timestamp callback.
controls.expectedResult: Callback is rejected; no delivery/payment status is changed.

controls.scenario: Repeatedly fail a synthetic delivery job using classified transient failures.
controls.expectedResult: Retries are bounded with approved backoff/jitter and terminal/dead-letter status.

controls.scenario: Resolve a retryable failure before exhaustion.
controls.expectedResult: Job resumes and records attempts without duplicate delivery state.

controls.scenario: Leave a job in UNKNOWN/stuck state beyond approved threshold.
controls.expectedResult: Reconciler queries provider/backend and alerts when unresolved.

controls.scenario: Restore provider connectivity after a stuck result.
controls.expectedResult: Reconciler converges to an evidence-backed state without duplicate side effect.

controls.scenario: Rotate/re-enroll an authorized Gateway identity following approved process.
controls.expectedResult: New registered identity can authenticate within assigned scope.

controls.scenario: Use a revoked/lost/old device credential or mismatched installation ID.
controls.expectedResult: Provider rejects commands/claims from the revoked identity.

controls.scenario: Receive provider/carrier receipt that explicitly supports delivered status.
controls.expectedResult: System may mark DELIVERED with linked receipt evidence.

controls.scenario: Receive only accepted/submitted/queued ACK without delivery receipt.
controls.expectedResult: System does not report customer/recipient delivery as confirmed.

controls.scenario: Run TEST request against the dedicated local TEST database/provider targets.
controls.expectedResult: Only the configured local TEST resources are selected.

controls.scenario: Attempt to configure an external/legacy/LIVE target in the local foundation.
controls.expectedResult: Static/runtime guard rejects the target before connecting.
controls.evidenceRequired: Environment isolation test using non-production sentinel targets.

controls.scenario: Create a local custom-format database backup and verify checksum/listing.
controls.expectedResult: Backup artifact and SHA-256 manifest are produced.

controls.scenario: Restore to a disposable isolated local DB and validate schema/rows/time.
controls.expectedResult: Restore contents are consistent and RPO/RTO measurements are recorded.

controls.scenario: Inventory GPS, KYC, payments, OTP/audit, app logs and backup classes.
controls.expectedResult: Each class has owner, purpose, retention period and deletion/hold path.

controls.scenario: Create a record past approved retention in an isolated test fixture.
controls.expectedResult: Retention job/policy applies correctly without deleting legally held data.

controls.scenario: Upload/download an allowed private file for its authorized owner.
controls.expectedResult: Object remains private and permitted lifecycle/metadata checks pass.

controls.scenario: Attempt unauthorized object access, disallowed MIME/type or oversize upload.
controls.expectedResult: Access/upload is rejected; no public object exposure.

controls.scenario: Request authorized data export/deletion for a test account.
controls.expectedResult: Scope, ownership, confirmation and audit follow approved workflow.

controls.scenario: Attempt another actor’s export/deletion or delete held/required financial/audit records.
controls.expectedResult: Unauthorized/held data operations are blocked and audited.

controls.scenario: Create a mobile session and inspect platform storage implementation on Android/iOS.
controls.expectedResult: Session token is stored only in platform secure storage, not general AsyncStorage/preferences.

controls.scenario: Logout/revoke the session and inspect local state.
controls.expectedResult: Secrets are cleared/invalidated; protected calls fail after revoke.

controls.scenario: Scan app source, bundled config and release artifacts for server private/master keys.
controls.expectedResult: No private server key or master secret is embedded in the client.

controls.scenario: Attempt privileged control action from an untrusted device/client identity.
controls.expectedResult: Backend denies it without approved key/device trust and authorization.

controls.scenario: Navigate core screens with a simulated offline/stale state.
controls.expectedResult: UI clearly identifies stale/offline status and offers safe retry.

controls.scenario: Trigger failed booking/payment/trip write then retry.
controls.expectedResult: UI does not show false success or duplicate transaction.

controls.scenario: Load Web Admin from approved origin with valid session and ordinary content.
controls.expectedResult: Expected secure headers/CORS and safe output rendering apply.

controls.scenario: Inject HTML/script payload and attempt cross-origin/CSRF state change.
controls.expectedResult: Payload is escaped/rejected and unauthorized browser action is blocked.

controls.scenario: Check liveness while app is up and readiness with required local DB available.
controls.expectedResult: Liveness and dependency readiness report their intended distinct states.

controls.scenario: Simulate DB unavailable or environment-marker mismatch.
controls.expectedResult: Readiness fails safely; no credential/schema detail is exposed.

controls.scenario: Prepare a known-good artifact and compatible schema-forward recovery route.
controls.expectedResult: Release manifest and restore/forward-fix steps are reproducible.

controls.scenario: Simulate a failed release/migration in disposable local test setup.
controls.expectedResult: Rollback/forward-fix restores service/data integrity without reusing legacy DB.

controls.scenario: Prepare release manifest for a TEST build.
controls.expectedResult: Commit/source ID, artifact hash, migrations, tests, approver, environment and recovery reference are present.

controls.scenario: Attempt release missing critical evidence/approver/environment identity.
controls.expectedResult: Release gate rejects incomplete manifest.

controls.scenario: Generate synthetic API errors/latency, DB/job/OTP/payment events.
controls.expectedResult: Metrics and alerts are attributable to an owner with bounded labels and safe correlation.

controls.scenario: Generate query secrets or actor-specific values in requests/events.
controls.expectedResult: Metrics and alert labels avoid raw query strings, tokens and unbounded PII labels.

controls.scenario: Run an incident tabletop with severity, incident ID, owner and escalation.
controls.expectedResult: Containment, communications, evidence preservation and postmortem owner are assigned.

controls.scenario: Simulate credential/device compromise in TEST.
controls.expectedResult: Revocation/rotation, service recovery and follow-up tracking occur per runbook.

controls.scenario: Run the approved critical Customer, Driver, Admin, payment, OTP and Gateway journeys in TEST after implementation.
controls.expectedResult: Each journey meets acceptance criteria with build/version/environment evidence.

controls.scenario: Inject one controlled failure at each critical integration boundary.
controls.expectedResult: Expected failure/retry/recovery is shown without false success or duplicate business effects.

controls.scenario: Run the approved baseline load profile and record p95/p99/error rate/resource usage.
controls.expectedResult: Measured results are compared to explicitly approved targets.

controls.scenario: Inject slow/unavailable DB/provider/network and queue bursts.
controls.expectedResult: System degrades within approved limits and recovers without data/financial corruption.
